name: LT - Cold Outreach CSV -> Postgres Ingest (Staged)

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Apollo_Contacts" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  apollo_contact_id TEXT,
  apollo_account_id TEXT,
  first_name TEXT,
  last_name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  company_name_for_emails TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  email_status TEXT,
  primary_email_source TEXT,
  primary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  email_confidence NUMERIC,
  primary_email_catch_all_status TEXT,
  primary_email_last_verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  seniority TEXT,
  departments TEXT,
  sub_departments TEXT,
  contact_owner TEXT,
  work_direct_phone TEXT,
  home_phone TEXT,
  mobile_phone TEXT,
  corporate_phone TEXT,
  other_phone TEXT,
  stage TEXT,
  lists TEXT,
  last_contacted TIMESTAMPTZ,
  account_owner TEXT,
  employees_count INTEGER,
  industry TEXT,
  keywords TEXT,
  person_linkedin_url TEXT,
  website TEXT,
  company_linkedin_url TEXT,
  facebook_url TEXT,
  twitter_url TEXT,
  city TEXT,
  state TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  company_address TEXT,
  company_city TEXT,
  company_state TEXT,
  company_country TEXT,
  company_phone TEXT,
  technologies TEXT,
  annual_revenue NUMERIC,
  total_funding NUMERIC,
  latest_funding TEXT,
  latest_funding_amount NUMERIC,
  last_raised_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  subsidiary_of TEXT,
  email_sent BOOLEAN,
  email_open BOOLEAN,
  email_bounced BOOLEAN,
  replied BOOLEAN,
  demoed BOOLEAN,
  number_of_retail_locations INTEGER,
  secondary_email TEXT,
  secondary_email_source TEXT,
  secondary_email_status TEXT,
  secondary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  tertiary_email TEXT,
  tertiary_email_source TEXT,
  tertiary_email_status TEXT,
  tertiary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  primary_intent_topic TEXT,
  primary_intent_score NUMERIC,
  secondary_intent_topic TEXT,
  secondary_intent_score NUMERIC,
  qualify_contact TEXT,
  tags TEXT,
  source_sheet TEXT,
  source_segment TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB,
  source TEXT DEFAULT 'apollo',
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_uidx_contact_id
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (apollo_contact_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_idx_email_lower
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (LOWER(email));
